title: Audit policy
description: Declares which checks apply to which gate, which of them block, and where this project's commands come from. Declarative on purpose: the engine holds no project-specific assumption.

policyVersion.description: Contract version of this document. A different value is an incompatible policy and blocks; it is never read on a best-effort basis.

gates.description: One entry per gate name. A gate absent from here cannot be run.

tooling.description: Declared project commands. Never inferred: every entry names the file it was read from, and the engine verifies that file exists rather than guessing what the project runs.

repository.description: The one repository this policy may run against. Required, because a policy that cites another repository's files and line numbers produces confident rows about a repository nobody audited when it is run anywhere else.

remote.description: Name of the Git remote the identity is read from. The identity comes from that remote's url and from nothing else; the directory name is never consulted.

expected.description: The repository this policy was written for. Compared case-insensitively against the parsed remote url.

checkTimeoutMs.description: Wall-clock budget for ONE check. Each check runs in its own terminable worker and gets this budget in full; a larger catalogue never eats into it.

discoveryTimeoutMs.description: Wall-clock budget for building the WHOLE catalogue. Loading N modules is one bounded operation, budgeted separately from the checks it produces.

required.description: Required checks decide the gate verdict. Optional ones are recorded and never block.

with.description: Parameters for this check. Validated against the check's declared parameter contract; an unknown key blocks.

skip.description: Do not execute this check, and record NOT_RUN with this exact reason. A skipped check that is still required blocks, which is what keeps a skip from being a silent waiver.

run.description: The command line as declared. This delivery does not execute it.

format.description: How the cited region holds the command. Stated, never inferred from the file extension: 'yaml-run' reads the region's run: field, 'literal' compares the whole region. Comparison is exact in both cases.

source.description: Repository-relative path this command was read from, optionally with a #Lnn suffix. The engine verifies the path is tracked; it never derives a command from a manifest.

appliesTo.description: Repository-relative manifest paths this command covers.
